correctness.rationale: PASS. Gallo–Videla original star class-three Lie presentation has L=Fc ⊕ U ⊕ U_A ⊕ wedge^2 U, and in characteristic 2 [X,Y]=(tv-su)_A+(u∧b-v∧a). Central wedge coordinates drop out of commuting probability. Zero wedge fiber F=(q+1)q^m-q; each nonzero decomposable bivector has q(q^2-1) ordered preimages because same exterior product means change of basis determinant one; number of distinct nonzero decomposable outputs is ((q^m-1)(q^m-q))/(q(q^2-1)). For hub coordinates t=s=0 commuting noncentral pairs count F^2+q(q^2-1)(q^m-1)(q^m-q); for any of q²-1 nonzero (t,s) they count q^m F. Expansion yields numerator 2q²(q+1)q^{2m}-q²(q+1)²q^m+q^4 over sample q^{2+4m}. Quotient condition tv=su alone gives q^{-2}+(1-q^{-2})q^{-m}. All q even powers and m≥3 follow algebraically, including fixed-q asymptotics. Independent exact brute bracket counting for q=2,m=2 and 3 respectively gave 256/1024 and 1264/16384=79/1024, matching closed formula; finite tests are corroboration.
